text: Committee members will discuss French language needs for refugee newcomers to Toronto which was raised by René C. Viau, Committee member.

The French Language Advisory Committee recommends to the Government Management Committee that: 1. The Executive Director, Social Development, Finance and Administration, engage the Centre francophone de Toronto, La Passerelle-I.D.É., and other Francophone organizations, as appropriate, to ensure that the linguistic needs of refugee newcomers from Montréal to Toronto are taken into account.
